items.sentence: A: 呢件事係咪你嘅錯？ B: 你話啦。
items.jyutping: A: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 mai6 nei5 ge3 co3? B: nei5 waa6 laa1.
items.meaning: A: Is this your fault? B: You tell me.

items.sentence: 我唔記得帶鎖匙，依家點好？你話啦。
items.jyutping: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so3 si4, ji4 gaa1 dim2 hou2? nei5 waa6 laa1.
items.meaning: I forgot to bring the keys, what should I do now? You tell me.

items.sentence: 咁多嘅選擇，你點揀？你話啦。
items.jyutping: gam2 do1 ge3 syun2 zaak6, nei5 dim2 gaan2? nei5 waa6 laa1.
items.meaning: There are so many options, how do you choose? You tell me.

items.sentence: 你覺得佢講得啱定錯？你話啦。
items.jyutping: nei5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 gong2 dak1 aam1 ding6 co3? nei5 waa6 laa1.
items.meaning: Do you think what he said is right or wrong? You tell me.

items.sentence: 你真係咁都得？咁樣做會有問題㗎！
items.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 gam2 dou1 dak1? gam2 jo6 zou6 wui5 jau5 man6 tai4 gaa3!
items.meaning: You really can do that? Doing it like this will cause problems!

items.sentence: 佢竟然唔準備考試，咁都得？
items.jyutping: keoi5 ging2 jin4 m4 zeon2 bei6 haau2 si3, gam2 dou1 dak1?
items.meaning: He didn't prepare for the exam, seriously?

items.sentence: 咁貴嘅餐廳，你就咁都得？
items.jyutping: gam2 gwai3 ge3 caan1 teng1, nei5 zau6 gam2 dou1 dak1?
items.meaning: Such an expensive restaurant, you really settle for that?

items.sentence: 你買咗個壞咗嘅手機？咁都得？
items.jyutping: nei5 maai5 zo2 go3 waai6 zo2 ge3 sau2 gei1? gam2 dou1 dak1?
items.meaning: You bought a broken phone? Seriously?
